body: Implemented: claims are mirrored in <repo>/.git/pman/claims.json (common Git dir, shared by all worktrees, never committed). claim fails with CONFLICT if another worktree holds an active lease, next skips those tickets, release/done clear the entry; PMAN_SHARED_CLAIMS=0 disables it. Test with real git worktrees in test/claims.test.js.
author: local
